edinburgh_stgiles_verger.text: Welcome to St Giles'. Strictly it is the High Kirk of Edinburgh, and everyone calls it a cathedral anyway. It was one, briefly, under Charles I.
The crown-shaped spire dates from around 1500. John Knox, the firebrand preacher of the Reformation, was minister here in the 1560s.
The Thistle Chapel, finished in 1911, has an angel playing the bagpipes carved in stone. See if you can find her.

edinburgh_stgiles_visitor.text: Tradition says that in 1637 a woman called Jenny Geddes threw her stool at a minister reading from a new prayer book. I say she had a very good arm.
